_about: The four research agents' answer shapes, fixed in Milestone 1 of plan-research-workflow.md. research.js copies each schema inline into its agent() calls, because a workflow script can't read files. The fake-agent harness checks every set answer against these. Source sections are in spec-research-workflow.md.

research_topic.description: The {research-topic} slug. The plan file and the note use the same one.

topics.description: One entry per topic, in plan order. No maximum here: the script enforces the cap of 15.

waits_on.description: Topic numbers this topic waits on. Empty when it waits on nothing.

result.description: found: the findings file is written. none or failed: no file was written.

research-writer._source: spec-research-workflow.md 04 item 11, and 11 Decisions Log item 105

note.description: The note's path inside the project folder, such as Research/research-memory-extraction.md.

check.description: matches findings: a claim or footnote doesn't match the findings. coverage: a plan question is neither answered nor listed under Open Research Questions. nothing dropped: a finding that answers a plan question is missing from the note.
